description: The latest recorded dependency scan of ONE app, per stage (production and sandbox): each stage's `status`, the manifest it read, and its findings, each with `name`, `version`, `ecosystem`, advisory `ids` and `fixed` (the version that resolves them, or null when no fix is published yet — null never means harmless). Use it before changing a manifest or lockfile to see what is actually flagged on the live release, and after a release to check a finding is gone. READ `status` FIRST: `ok` and `findings` are scan results; `skipped`, `error` or no scan row mean the stage was NOT scanned, which is not a clean result. Coverage is per manifest: a manifest not named in `manifests_scanned` was never read. Report-only: findings never block a deploy. Any member of the app; the same findings the scan-opened requests carry.
name: appcrane_get_app_scan
